anyOf.description:
When a unit's executions need an invocation's approval.

Written as `auto` (the default), `manual` (short for
`{mode: manual, bind: desired}`), or `{mode, bind, requireDigest}`.

bind.description: What an approval authorizes: one execution of the `desired` document, or the changes a reviewed `plan` showed.

requireDigest.description: Refuse approvals without a change digest, for `bind: plan`.

ApprovalPolicy.description: `auto` (default), `manual` (short for {mode: manual, bind: desired}), or {mode, bind, requireDigest}.

AttestationDeclaration.description: One attestation a unit's receipts can carry.

from.description: `external` for an attestation only `nyl attest` supplies; omitted for one the kind produces itself.

DeletionPolicy.description: What happens to a unit's resources when it leaves the ownership set.

anyOf.description: A unit of the same environment.
A unit, optionally of another declared environment, with required evidence.

DependsOn.description:
A unit that must have a current receipt before this one runs: a name, or
an entry naming another declared environment or stronger evidence.

attestations.description: The producer's attestations to require, instead of all it declares.

environment.description: Another declared environment; default this one.

evidence.description: Required evidence: `published` (a current receipt, the default) or `attested`.

EnvAdmission.description:
Variables admitted into a unit's tool environment. Values are never part
of the execution key; only names are.

passthrough.description: Names of runner environment variables copied as they are.

secrets.description: Variables read from the project's secrets provider, by variable name and secret key. An object or array secret is passed as compact JSON.

Evidence.description: Evidence a consumer requires from its producer.

oneOf.description: A current receipt whose required attestations pass.

GitOpsResourceMetadata.description: Metadata shared by local GitOps compiler resources.

labels.description: Literal labels used for organization and target selection.

name.description: Project-local identity, validated by the resource kind; remains static during discovery.

GitSource.description:
A directory or file in a Git repository: this repository when no
repository is named, otherwise a remote one, optionally pinned to a commit.

commit.description: Full 40-character lowercase commit ID that is read, refreshed by `nyl update source-locks`.

path.description: Path in the repository. In this repository it follows the local path rule: relative to the directory containing `nyl.toml`, may begin with `..` segments, or starts with `/` to name a path from the Git worktree root, and never leaves the worktree. In a remote repository it is relative to the checkout root, with an optional leading `/`.

repository.description: Inline repository coordinates to read from. Mutually exclusive with `repositoryRef`.

repositoryRef.description: Project-local `gitops.nyl/v1` GitRepository to read from. Mutually exclusive with inline `repository`.

revision.description: Human-readable branch or tag that `nyl update source-locks` resolves.

from.description: Buildx cache import specifications passed as `--cache-from`.

to.description: Buildx cache export specifications passed as `--cache-to`.

ImageContext.description: A directory source or an image reference for a named Buildx context.

ImageReference.description: An image context. Its reference can be supplied by a `fromUnit` artifact binding.

image.description: A digest-pinned image reference or a `fromUnit` artifact binding.

InputType.description: Declared input type. Every type is a subset of JSON Schema.

oneOf.description: A JSON integer; numbers with a fractional part are rejected.
A JSON object. Only the top-level type is checked.
A JSON array. Only the top-level type is checked.

name.description: Project-local name of the referenced resource; its kind and API group are determined by the containing field.

OciImageSpec.description: Docker Buildx inputs. Every directory context is a separately pinned Git source.

approval.description: Whether executions need an invocation's approval.

attestations.description: Attestations of the unit's receipts: names its kind produces itself, or entries with `from: external` that only `nyl attest` supplies.

buildArgs.description: Build arguments, with references resolved before execution. Values must resolve to scalars.

builder.description: Runner's Buildx builder; excluded from the execution key.

cache.description: Buildx cache imports and exports; excluded from the execution key.

context.description: Main build context, following the common Git source and local path rules.

contexts.description: Named directories or digest-pinned image references, passed with `--build-context`.

deletionPolicy.description: What happens to the unit's resources when it leaves the ownership set. Default `Teardown` where the kind supports teardown, else `Retain`.

dependsOn.description: Units that must have a current receipt first, for ordering without a data reference.

dockerfile.description: Dockerfile relative to the main context, default `Dockerfile`; cannot leave the context.

enabled.description: Evaluated after rendering; `false` leaves the environment's ownership set, which deletes the unit under its `deletionPolicy`.

env.description: Variables and secrets admitted into the unit's otherwise empty tool environment.

outputs.description: Declared outputs, for kinds that let units declare them. Only declared outputs are recorded.

platforms.description: Target platforms, such as `linux/amd64`. Omitted uses the builder's platform.

registryAuth.description: Registry host to username/password secret keys. Values never enter state or execution keys.

repository.description: Registry repository without a tag or digest, such as `registry.example.com/team/web`.

tags.description: Extra moving tags in this repository. Consumers use the immutable artifact reference.

timeout.description: Deadline for one execution, teardown, or verification, at most `7d`. Default per kind.

OutputDeclaration.description: One declared output: a type from the Release input type set.

sensitive.description: Validated but never persisted, and never referenceable.

ReadGitRepository.description: Credential-free coordinates for a repository that is only read.

repoURL.description: Git read URL. Source checkouts never publish to this repository.

RegistryAuth.description: Secret keys for one registry; the runner never reads undeclared credentials.

passwordSecret.description: Project secret key containing this registry's password or access token.

usernameSecret.description: Project secret key containing this registry's username.

description:
Builds and pushes an immutable container image with Docker Buildx.

Consumers read the `image` ContainerImage artifact by digest. Registry
credentials come only from the declared `registryAuth` keys or `env`.

metadata.description: Literal unit name and labels used for environment selection.

spec.description: The build inputs, registry destination, and common unit policy.
